ei.title: Request for a Discount on a Bulk Order
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Dear Pollet Toys, We are considering ordering 50 striped 2-inch plastic balls for the city-wide Youth Activity Day on June 14. According to your website, the balls are normally sold in individual plastic and cardboard packages. However, we will not need packaging or transportation for our order as we can pick up the balls, packed loose in cardboard boxes, directly from your warehouse. Given these circumstances, I would like to request a discount on our order. I believe that a discount of at least 25% would be reasonable. If you agree to this, please confirm the agreement in writing. If not, I would appreciate a call at 555-5555 as soon as possible so we can reach a mutually agreeable arrangement. I look forward to your positive response and hope that we can finalize the order details soon. Sincerely, Granville Community Center

questions.passage: Dear Pollet Toys, We are considering ordering 50 striped 2-inch plastic balls for the city-wide Youth Activity Day on June 14. According to your website, the balls are (A)[normally / rarely] sold in individual plastic and cardboard packages. However, we will not need (B)[packaging / delivering] or transportation for our order as we can pick up the balls, packed loose in cardboard boxes, directly from your warehouse. Given these circumstances, I would like to request a discount on our order. I believe that a discount of at least 25% would be (C)[reasonable / excessive]. If you agree to this, please confirm the agreement in writing. If not, I would appreciate a call at 555-5555 as soon as possible so we can reach a mutually agreeable arrangement. I look forward to your positive response and hope that we can finalize the order details soon. Sincerely, Granville Community Center
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② normally - packaging - reasonable = 원문 일치
❌ ① rarely: 보통 팔린다는 맥락에서 '드물게'는 부적절
❌ ③ delivering/excessive: 포장 불필요+합리적 할인 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ rarely/delivering/excessive: 세 단어 모두 원문과 불일치

③ indirectly: 창고에서 '간접적으로' 가져간다 → 직접 가져간다는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

③ appreciate: 전화를 주시면 감사하겠다 → 적절
